dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Eosinophilic esophagitis
Alternatives:
Pill-induced esophagitis
Peptic esophageal stricture (from chronic GERD)
Esophageal motility disorder (e.g., achalasia, distal esophageal spasm, jackhammer esophagus)
order_raw:
1. Upper endoscopy (esophagogastroduodenoscopy) with esophageal biopsies
2. Barium swallow (esophagram)
3. Esophageal high-resolution manometry
4. Complete blood count with iron studies
5. Medication review for potential pill-induced esophagitis (e.g., bisphosphonates, NSAIDs, doxycycline, potassium supplements) — if not already determined, ask patient to list medications
